TestSchemaFileInSnapshot::test_restore_d.description: 1 node. Creates a table with one column per native CQL type (20 types), inserts 3 rows, takes a ks snapshot (copied to tmp), records DESCRIBE TABLE. Guards the schema.cql round trip for all native types (scylladb/scylladb#4192).
